class.name: LatexLabel
class.brief_description: Displays a LaTeX math expression using MicroTeX.
class.description: Enter an expression such as [code]\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}[/code] in [member text]. [LatexLabel] uses embedded math fonts and draws the result on the Godot canvas. Its minimum size follows the dimensions of the formula. Use [member label_settings] to share a font size and color between labels, or override the [code]font_size[/code] and [code]font_color[/code] theme items. Theme values fall back to the [Label] theme.

method.name: get_render_error
method.description: Returns the error from the last attempt to lay out [member text]. Returns an empty string if the expression rendered successfully or is empty. The label lays out its expression after entering the scene tree.

members.member: Clips formula drawing to the control's rectangle. The formula can be laid out in a narrower control when enabled. Its height and the normal stylebox margins still contribute to the minimum size.
Uses display math style when enabled and the more compact inline math style when disabled.
Aligns the formula horizontally. Left and right mirror in right-to-left layouts. Fill places the formula at the left without stretching it.
Uses the resource's font size and font color in preference to the theme. Changes to a shared resource update the formula. The glyphs use the embedded math fonts.
The LaTeX expression to display. Supply the formula directly, for example [code]\sum_{n=1}^{10} n^2[/code].
Aligns the formula vertically inside the normal stylebox margins. Fill places the formula at the top.

theme_items.theme_item: Foreground color for the formula when [member label_settings] is unset.
Formula size when [member label_settings] is unset.
Background drawn when the control has keyboard focus.
Default background and content margins for the formula.
